أنفتح (form VII)
# أَنْفَتِحُ (ʔanfatiḥu) /ʔan.fa.ti.ħu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# أَنْفَتِحَ (ʔanfatiḥa) /ʔan.fa.ti.ħa/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
# أَنْفَتِحْ (ʔanfatiḥ) /ʔan.fa.tiħ/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِنْفَتَحَ (infataḥa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
